races.name: Archon
races.desc: Builder-constructs left behind by the Precursors. Slow and gentle, but tough, fireproof, need no air and fix anything.

weapons.name: Prism Lance
weapons.desc: Precursor light bent through a crystal. Every shot slips through one shield layer.

weapons.name: Phase Beam
weapons.desc: A beam that is only partly in this universe. Ignores one shield layer.

drones.name: Vault Sentinel
drones.desc: A Precursor guardian orb that shoots down missiles, drones and hacking probes.

augments.name: Precursor Core
augments.desc: A heart of ancient engineering. Shields recharge 15% faster, weapons charge 5% faster and repairs go 15% faster.

sectors.name: The Precursor Vaults
sectors.blurb: Sealed vaults of a vanished people, guarded by machines that never sleep. Treasure for those who can open them.
intro: Silent structures older than any star chart. Your sensors light up with signals nobody has answered in a million years.
The Precursor Vaults. Watch for the guardians.

events.text: A vault door the size of a moon, covered in moving symbols. A power socket below it pulses, waiting.

choices.text: Feed it power from your shields.

effect.text: The door drinks your shield energy and slides open. Inside: a hoard of salvage and a working Precursor gun.

success.text: Your crew cut a hole and slip inside before the guardians wake.

fail.text: The door does not like being cut.

effect.text: Your nav computer uses them to plot a few shortcuts.

events.text: A calm voice speaks from a crystal obelisk. "I have no voice, yet I answer. I have no ship, yet I travel. What am I?"

effect.text: "Correct." The obelisk opens and offers you a gift.

success.text: "Close enough." The obelisk drops a cache of old parts.

fail.text: "Incorrect." A guardian unfolds from the obelisk.

effect.text: The obelisk is silent for a long time. Then a guardian unfolds from it, very slowly.

events.text: A library vault: endless shelves of glowing crystals, each one holding a lifetime of knowledge. An Archon construct tends them, alone.

effect.text: Your gunners learn more in an hour than in years of drills.
The Archon considers this for a full minute. Then it picks up a toolbox and follows you.

choices.text: Take a few crystals to sell.

events.text: A Precursor beacon wakes as you pass and paints a path on your star chart to something it calls "the Heart".

effect.text: The Heart is marked on your map.

events.text: The Heart: a glowing sphere at the centre of a vast cage of machinery. Its warden turns to face you, every gun charging.

effect.text: It has been waiting a million years for this.

afterWin.text: The cage opens. The Heart's core is yours.

effect.text: {who} speaks in a language nobody has heard in a million years. The warden bows and opens the cage.
The warden lets you go. This time.

events.text: A wrecked vault, cracked open by some ancient battle. Debris drifts everywhere, some of it still humming.

success.text: One of them is a working defence orb.

fail.text: One of them is a guardian, and it is awake.
